ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.title: A new user cannot be created
ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.impact: New local accounts cannot be added through the administrator interface, even with valid account fields and a strong matching password.
ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.retest: Create a previously unused username through Admin. The expected not-found response during availability checking should be handled and the account should be created once.

screenshots.caption: Submitting valid input returns HTTP 500. No ui_rehearsal account was created.

ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.title: An existing user cannot be opened for editing
ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.impact: Account details and roles cannot be managed through the existing-user edit screen.
ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.retest: Open user_two from the administrator user list. The form should be populated from the current SDK response model, then a reversible profile edit should be saved and reloaded.

screenshots.caption: Selecting user_two from Manage users returns HTTP 500 before the edit form can be shown.

BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.title: The next account inherits the previous basket
BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.impact: On a shared browser, another person's selection can be mistaken for the current account's selection. This observation does not demonstrate a sample-permission bypass.
BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.retest: Select samples as user_one, log out and log in as user_two in the same browser. Independent selections, or an explicitly documented shared-browser policy, should be verified.

screenshots.caption: After switching to user_two, all nine samples selected by user_one remain in the basket. Removing or clearing also changes the shared selection.

NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.title: An unauthorized admin visit returns a server error
NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.impact: A non-admin user gets an HTTP 500 page rather than a useful denial or redirect. Administrative data was not displayed.
NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.retest: Visit /admin/users as user_two. A clear denial or a valid redirect should be returned without a server error.

screenshots.caption: A direct non-admin visit to user management returns HTTP 500. The denial path targets the nonexistent public.home endpoint.

METADATA-ADD-500.title: Valid metadata cannot be added
METADATA-ADD-500.impact: Adding ordinary text or numeric metadata fails with HTTP 500.
METADATA-ADD-500.retest: Append a new field and verify existing fields remain intact.

PRIVATE-GROUP-INVITE-500.title: Private groups cannot be created with invited users
PRIVATE-GROUP-INVITE-500.impact: A private group with a valid invitation returns HTTP 500.
PRIVATE-GROUP-INVITE-500.retest: Create a private group with one invited account; verify owner, invitee and uninvited access separately.

QC-FILTER-EMPTY.title: An exact status filter hides matching rows
QC-FILTER-EMPTY.impact: The advanced table filter excludes a row that visibly has the requested status.
QC-FILTER-EMPTY.retest: Combine a category filter with QC Equals failed; only matching rows should remain.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: an exact status filter hides matching rows.

PENDING-SAMPLE-500.title: A pending record cannot be opened
PENDING-SAMPLE-500.impact: A valid record without a completed pipeline returns HTTP 500 instead of an available pending state.
PENDING-SAMPLE-500.retest: Open empty and metadata-only records without supplying any analysis data.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: a pending record cannot be opened.
Baseline observation: a pending record cannot be opened.

GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.title: Applying unchanged groups removes other memberships
GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.impact: Selecting records with one common group and applying without changes removes their individual memberships. This can silently change organization of records.
GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.retest: Apply an unchanged common selection to records with different additional memberships; verify every original edge remains.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: applying unchanged groups removes other memberships.
Baseline observation: applying unchanged groups removes other memberships.

GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LIMIT.title: Group preselection fails above 100 selected records
GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LIMIT.impact: The selector silently loses common group preselection for a 125-record selection.
GROUP-MEMBERSHIP-LIMIT.retest: Select 125 members of a common group and verify preselection and a harmless Apply.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: group preselection fails above 100 selected records.

METADATA-CATEGORY-LOSS.title: Interleaved metadata categories lose fields
METADATA-CATEGORY-LOSS.impact: An earlier field disappears when another category occurs between two fields of the same category.
METADATA-CATEGORY-LOSS.retest: Display categories A, B, A and verify all fields appear once.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: interleaved metadata categories lose fields.

METADATA-TABLE-EMPTY.title: An accepted metadata table has no visible contents
METADATA-TABLE-EMPTY.impact: Accepted CSV metadata cannot be read as an inline or standalone table.
METADATA-TABLE-EMPTY.retest: Create a small generic CSV table and verify its headings, cells and category placement.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: an accepted metadata table has no visible contents.

SELECTED-FILTER-STALE.title: Clearing selected rows leaves stale filtered results
SELECTED-FILTER-STALE.impact: Show only selected continues displaying the old rows after Deselect all. The settled state was confirmed.
SELECTED-FILTER-STALE.retest: Deselect all while the selected-row filter is active; the table should become empty.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: clearing selected rows leaves stale filtered results.

GROUP-EDITOR-EMPTY-COUNT.title: A populated group editor reports no members
GROUP-EDITOR-EMPTY-COUNT.impact: The editor says No samples added yet for a group with 123 members.
GROUP-EDITOR-EMPTY-COUNT.retest: Open a populated group editor and compare its count with the membership records.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: a populated group editor reports no members.

BASKET-UNDEFINED-ASSAY.title: Pending records display undefined in the basket
BASKET-UNDEFINED-ASSAY.impact: A missing optional category is printed as literal undefined.
BASKET-UNDEFINED-ASSAY.retest: Add a pending record to the basket; a readable empty value should be shown.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: pending records display undefined in the basket.

COMMENT-HIDE-PERMISSION-500.title: A comment control offers an action that fails
COMMENT-HIDE-PERMISSION-500.impact: A regular account is shown Remove, but using it returns HTTP 500. Administrator removal succeeds.
COMMENT-HIDE-PERMISSION-500.retest: Keep the established permission policy and make the control and denial feedback agree with it.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: a comment control offers an action that fails.
Baseline observation: a comment control offers an action that fails.

OVERVIEW-MOBILE-OVERFLOW.title: The overview is wider than a phone screen
OVERVIEW-MOBILE-OVERFLOW.impact: At both 320 px and 390 px, the overview expands to 1488 CSS pixels rather than containing horizontal table scrolling.
OVERVIEW-MOBILE-OVERFLOW.retest: Review narrow-screen navigation, action controls and table scrolling; the report itself is checked separately.

screenshots.caption: Baseline observation: the overview is wider than a phone screen.
Baseline observation: the overview is wider than a phone screen.

GROUP-DELETE-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.title: Deleting one group removes memberships in other groups
GROUP-DELETE-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.impact: Records remain after group deletion, but their unrelated group memberships can be silently lost. A fresh one-record, two-group probe reproduced the loss on the unchanged baseline.
GROUP-DELETE-MEMBERSHIP-LOSS.retest: Delete group A while one of its records also belongs to B. The record and its B membership must remain, and B’s count must be unchanged.
